need.role: Stationary target the player punches to test timing and trigger the hit counter.
need.constraints: Humanoid-shaped stationary practice dummy, roughly 5-6 studs tall, matte gym/gray color scheme, anchored base or stand, R15-compatible rig acceptable but no locomotion needed, no moving parts required, must have a clear torso/head hitbox for touch or proximity hit detection.

intent.experienceRole: Serves as the practice target players repeatedly punch to test their combat timing and trigger scoring feedback, anchoring the entire gameplay loop.
intent.interaction: Player approaches and presses the attack input to swing at the dummy; on a successful hit the game plays the hit sound and immediately increments the on-screen hit counter. The dummy itself does not move, attack back, or reset.
reusableFeatures: Existing humanoid rig or part layout usable as a hitbox for touch detection
Any built-in idle or wobble animation already on the dummy model
Anchored base plate or stand geometry included with the model

review.reason: Current evidence has zero sourceBodies, confirming removal of the Respawn script (before-index 18, ff6eaa79...) which polled Humanoid.Health and used deprecated makeJoints()/clone-destroy to reset the dummy, conflicting with the never-resets requirement and serving no gameplay purpose here. Static hitbox geometry (parts, meshes, Head, Torso, Decal, Humanoid) survives unmodified per mapping. No scripts remain to review, no removed capabilities are listed, and no linked requirement is unknown, so this component qualifies as an integration candidate for the static dummy geometry; placement, sound, and HUD remain separately owned integration work.
